flowConfiguration.name: SharePoint Process Owners Extractor
flowConfiguration.description: Extracts Process Owner and Manager information from multiple SharePoint sites

sharePointSites.description: Add all your SharePoint site URLs here

excelFilePath.description: Path to your Excel file in SharePoint or OneDrive

fieldPatterns.description: Patterns to match in field names

actions.name: ProcessItems
actions.description: Extract person fields from each item

updateExcel.description: Update Excel table with extracted data

extractProcessName.description: Extract process name from field name like 'SITS Process Owners'

checkIfFieldMatches.description: Check if field name contains any of the patterns

determineFieldType.description: Determine if field is Owner or Manager

extractEmailFromPeoplePicker.description: Extract email from people picker field

extractNameFromPeoplePicker.description: Extract display name from people picker field

checkIfRecordExists.description: Check if record already exists in Excel

implementation-notes: 1. Create Excel file first with the schema defined above
2. Update sharePointSites array with your actual site URLs
3. Grant flow permissions to all SharePoint sites
4. Test with one site before deploying to all sites
5. Consider using SharePoint HTTP actions for better field detection
6. Add error handling scopes around each site processing
7. Set up email notifications for failures
8. Monitor API call limits - you may need premium license for HTTP actions

multiplePeopleInField.description: Handle when Process Owner field contains multiple people
multiplePeopleInField.approach: Use Apply to each on PersonField?['value'] array

dynamicFieldDetection.description: Automatically detect all person fields in lists
dynamicFieldDetection.approach: Use SharePoint Get List action to retrieve column schema, filter by FieldTypeKind = 20 (User)

incrementalUpdates.description: Only process items modified since last run
incrementalUpdates.approach: Store last run timestamp, filter SharePoint items by Modified >= LastRunDate

conflictResolution.description: Handle cases where same process has different owners in different sites
conflictResolution.approach: Add SourcePriority column, keep highest priority source
